verdict.rationale: Temporal can be self-hosted from its open-source GitHub repo via Docker, Kubernetes, or manual deployment, so a user isn't locked into the hosted cloud. Archival can move closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage, and the CLI can list workflows and namespaces, which gives some routes to extract data. There is no documented 'export all data' feature and no statement that the exported formats are open. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export path (including open/in-progress workflows and Cloud namespaces), documented open export formats, a Cloud-to-self-hosted migration guide, and hands-on corroboration of leaving with your data.
